senses.gloss: f. (פרכס q. v.) [the grinder, moving to and back,] the hopper, grain-receiver on top of the millstone.
units: <cite ref="Chagigah 3a">Ḥag. 3ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 89a:5">Ḥull. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>עשה אזנך כאפ׳</he> (ed. <he>כארפ׳</he>) make thy ear like the hopper to receive the teachings &c.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:9:3">Y. Kidd. I, end, 61ᵈ</cite> <he>נקב אזנך כאפרכס הזו</he> perforate (make open) thy ear &c.; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 10:1">Pesik. R. s. 10</cite> <he>הרעישה אזנך וכ׳</he> shake thy ear, like a hopper, to receive &c.
